note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI sends a 160-point Battlewagon on a 17% charge at a 4 wound Mek. It scores positive only because of large bonus terms. A failed charge leaves the wagon exposed to heavy shooting. Fix: Multiply every outcome bonus (can_wipe, can_halve, character, points_trade, order_round_aggression) by charge probability. Prefer a non-charge move or shooting instead.
